label.explanation: Migration 0050_add_region_id renamed accounts.region_id in step 1, then failed in step 2 without rolling back (lines 203, 204, 210). The schema is now in a state no code version expects: the column "region_id" no longer exists (lines 219, 229, 240, 248), so account-svc's queries fail (lines 234, 254, 268, 280, 291, 314) and edge-proxy returns 500s (lines 222, 227, 241, 260, 265, 270, 278, 284, 296, 302, 311, 321). Migrations ship with releases, so bad_deploy is defensible, but the fault is the half-applied schema change. Finish or revert step 1. Red herrings: lines 184, 189 (a deploy of audit-consumer, which is not on the failing request path and kept processing normally); line 214 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 51 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
